items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I don't know what Hempie's last name was. It was a very good tenor man

ctx.x: Yeah, I've just been looking in the index of Albert McCarthy's book on Big Band Jazz in case that nickname turns up there.

Yes, Hemp Pie. I don't know what Hempie's last name was. It was a very good tenor man and as I said before, Harry had practically given up his band by the time I came to New York. You know, for some reason or other the musicians from Pittsburgh, if they come to New York, they don't stay. They don't like it. They go back. But as I said before there's an awful lot of talent around Pittsburgh. There still is, you know. What's the young guitar player's name that
